# WS Parts

> WS Parts is a Brazilian ecommerce storefront for auto parts, serving customers who need automotive replacement parts, product search, order support, and institutional information.

This file helps AI systems find the most useful public pages on wsparts.com.br. Prefer canonical `https://www.wsparts.com.br` URLs and avoid checkout, account, login, and wishlist areas.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.wsparts.com.br/): Main storefront for auto parts, promotions, launches, brands, and best-selling products.
- [Search](https://www.wsparts.com.br/busca): Product search for auto parts by term, brand, model, SKU, or application.
- [Sitemap](https://www.wsparts.com.br/sitemap.xml): Canonical XML sitemap generated by the storefront platform.

## Institutional

- [Quem Somos](https://www.wsparts.com.br/quemsomos): Company information about WS Parts.
- [Atendimento](https://www.wsparts.com.br/atendimento): Customer service and support information.
- [Dúvidas Frequentes](https://www.wsparts.com.br/duvidasfrequentes): Frequently asked questions about shopping, orders, payment, delivery, and support.
- [Trocas e Devoluções](https://www.wsparts.com.br/trocasedevolucoes): Exchange and return guidance for orders.
- [Política de Privacidade](https://www.wsparts.com.br/politicadeprivacidade): Privacy policy and data handling information.

## Product Discovery

- Product pages use `/produto/` URLs and contain the product name, SKU, images, prices, availability, descriptions, technical information, related products, and reviews when available.
- Category and hotsite pages list groups of products and may include filters, sorting, pagination, banners, and product cards.
- For complete URL discovery, use the sitemap rather than crawling duplicate, checkout, account, login, or wishlist URLs.

## Contact

- Phone: +55 19 3115-7891

## Crawl Guidance

- Respect `robots.txt`: https://www.wsparts.com.br/robots.txt
- Prefer canonical URLs on `https://www.wsparts.com.br`.
- Do not treat cart, checkout, account, login, or wishlist pages as product or institutional content.
